reason: A workspace-scoped orchestration plugin that loads, manages, and isolates MCP servers per session workspace, including process launching, remote connections, tool registration, configuration reloads, and reconnection.

summaries.zh: 按会话工作区加载和管理 MCP server，将项目配置的工具隔离注册到对应 agent，并支持配置重载与断线重连。
summaries.en: Loads and manages MCP servers per session workspace, registering project-specific tools for the corresponding agent with configuration reloads and reconnection support.

capabilities: Loads MCP server definitions from a workspace configuration file
Spawns configured stdio MCP server processes
Connects to configured streamable HTTP MCP servers
Registers and refreshes MCP tools within agent scope
Watches configuration changes and reloads servers
Automatically retries failed MCP connections with backoff
